name: MarkerHighlightHeadline
job: A headline where chosen words get a hand-drawn marker highlight, underline or circle as it scrolls into view
mobile: same, marks reflow with line breaks
motion: marks draw in staggered left to right with eased stroke (reduced-motion: marks shown fully drawn)

notes: Worst-case overflow: grid item min-content grows with an unbreakable word; fix is overflow-wrap:anywhere on .headline plus min-inline-size:0 on .inner/.stage (not applied, gate cap reached).
